function.name: hotel_booking
function.description: Books a hotel room given the location, room type, stay duration and any additional preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

room_type.description: Type of the room required. Options: 'single', 'double', 'deluxe', etc.

duration.description: The number of nights you want to book the hotel for.

start_date.description: The date when your stay begins.

preferences.description: Optional preferences of stay at the hotel. Default is all if not specified.

function.name: soccer_get_last_match
function.description: Retrieve the details of the last match played by a specified soccer club. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the soccer club.

include_stats.description: If true, include match statistics like possession, shots on target etc. Default is false.

function.name: calculate_BMI
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) given a person's weight and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight_kg.description: The weight of the person in kilograms.

height_m.description: The height of the person in meters. This is a float type value.
